name: KromiumClipboard
summary: Facade for clipboard and editing operations.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Copies the current selection to the clipboard.

methods.name: paste
methods.description: Pastes the clipboard content into the current focused element.

methods.name: cut
methods.description: Cuts the current selection to the clipboard.

methods.name: selectAll
methods.description: Selects all text/content in the current focused element.

methods.name: redo
methods.description: Redoes the last undone editing action.
